purpose: Determine whether RS20 and two separate fixed price-structure descriptions differentiate subsequent20-session paths within original PVR deciles. No residual fit, new composite score, account, funding or orders.
mother: 133713 saved original legal unique-stock candidate CLOSEs; same CORE/MOBILE sid/day counted once; original account-path-dependent, static universe and sector nonPIT.
eligibility: Original PVR finite; same-date/sector known-PVR N>=10. Unknowns and N<10 remain in denominator reports. No residual is fitted at any N.
decile: Sort original PVR descending with the saved original pending PVR slot order (native round12 then H1 tie). d=1+floor(10*(ordinal_rank-1)/N); d=1 is highest. Keep all10 bins, including singleton bins.

features_separate.RS20: Existing relative_return20, stock simple20-observation return minus exact aligned sector simple return; same original clock.
features_separate.low_improvement: Previously frozen L=min(current5 valid closes)/min(preceding disjoint5 valid closes)-1, pre2022 source warmup preserved.

arms: For each feature separately, within the FIXED cell compute median of finite at-CLOSE values. HIGH iff strictly above median; LOW iff strictly below; exact median/ties neutral, missing feature UNKNOWN. Need at least1 in each arm. Freeze membership before loading future labels, never relabel after future censoring.
future_path: Native shared-calendar sessions t+1..t+20, not20 surviving valid rows. Current, nextOPEN and all20 future closes must be observed, positive finite, valid original PVR domain, same source block/segment. Otherwise UNKNOWN or source-tail censored; no forward fill.
complete_cell: Evaluate an arm pair only if every original known-PVR member of that fixed decile cell has complete20-session path, not just favorable members. Future attrition never changes decile, feature median or arms.
secondary_coordinate: Save the same three outcomes using decision CLOSE denominator. Positive maximum/negative minimum are not clipped to zero; only daily-close extrema, no executable intraday path.
cell_comparison: HIGH arithmetic mean outcome minus LOW arithmetic mean outcome; each feature separately. No tuned thresholds or grouping on future labels.
aggregation: First equal-weight evaluable decile deltas within date/sector. Then equal-weight sectors within date. Then equal-weight dates within each requested period. Also report sector-date distributions and each-decile results. Do not treat overlapping stock-days or cells as IID samples.

periods.2022_23: Decision dates2022-2023, future horizon may cross year if present in same source window.
periods.2024: Decision dates2024; source ends2024 and right tail stays censored.
periods.2025H2_2026H1: Original strong candidate/calendar starts2025-07, ends2026-06; 2025H1 missing, not reconstructed.

time_stability: Fixed nonoverlapping20-native-calendar-decision-session blocks starting at the beginning of each original source window. Report block mean signs and spread only. Adjacent blocks' forward paths can overlap near boundaries: no independent-block claim, IID standard error, p-value or significance.
remaining_PVR_balance: Report HIGH-LOW raw PVR score and within-date/sector PVR percentile. Same decile is not exact PVR equality; differences remain descriptive conditional association, not proven independent information.
global_diagnostic: Use all original same-date finite-PVR candidates with N>=10 to construct same equal-count PVR deciles. Report source arm/pair coverage and future complete-cell coverage only, plus sector mix and the potential coverage if each global bin is further split by sector. No global-bin future-performance selection or additional regression.
decision: No introduction of residual ranking on these data. If these conditional features do not show stable cross-period discrimination or only alter favorable/adverse tails together, state this directly; do not change bins, horizon or add a regression to rescue it.
